profile.summary: Common Vision is a nonprofit that works on education, food and the environment. It runs garden and environmental education programs at schools, food recovery and distribution programs, and tree planting and urban forestry projects, mostly in West Oakland.

review.notes: Common Vision (EIN 80-0615097, 501(c)(3), IRS address Berkeley) runs garden/food/tree programs at OUSD's Prescott Elementary (920 Campbell St), consistent with the no-cost agreements; summary is supported by commonvision.org and neutral. The 920 Campbell St address is the Prescott school campus where it operates, while the IRS mailing address is Berkeley.
